Raw magical heavy four-legged stone beast, squat broad body, blunt mineral horns and tall angular thorn-like back plates, ochre mineral seams, heavy blunt feet, small armored head. Keys 5-10: Six distinct locomotion keys in order: opposite diagonal leg pairs alternate support; reach, contact, gather, opposite reach, opposite contact, gather. Show clearly different left/right paw placement, not six copies with one leading leg. Keys 11-16: six ATTACK poses, ready, armored head lowers, weight gathers onto hind feet, brief forward horn shove, forefeet brace, ready recovery. All complete bodies same anatomical scale, very wide empty magenta gutters. No labels, no text, no anatomy outside its cell. No falling or resting poses. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only. Keep the approved BLUE illuminated mineral seams as well as ochre cracks. The approved image outranks any conflicting written color description. CORRECTION: The first attempt repeated standing poses. Draw real locomotion: pose 5 LEFT FOREFOOT reaches forward with right forefoot back; pose 6 left forefoot plants; pose 7 right forefoot passes left; pose 8 RIGHT FOREFOOT reaches forward with left back; pose 9 right plants; pose 10 left passes right. Near and far legs MUST alternate, visibly. Attack: head drops until horns point forward horizontally; hind legs compress; entire beast lunges with front feet briefly airborne; forefeet land and catch; body recoils; returns ready. Preserve front-right head view and exact grey blue-seamed stone identity. Keep six attack poses visibly different.

arguments.Prompt:
Stylized digital dark fantasy concept art animation sprite sheet on a solid, flat, uniform vivid MAGENTA (#FF00FF) background. A 4x4 grid layout containing exactly 16 complete, isolated animation poses arranged in 4 rows and 4 columns, separated by wide, empty vivid magenta gutters.

Subject & Anatomy:
A quadrupedal magical stone beast creature (Thornback), maintaining exact identity from the reference images: heavy four-legged stone beast with a squat broad body, blunt mineral horns on a small armored head, tall angular thorn-like stone back plates, textured grey rock hide with bright glowing blue illuminated mineral seams and warm ochre mineral cracks, and heavy blunt stone feet. Animal anatomy only—no humanoid elements, no armor, no clothing, no weapons, no riders.

Perspective & Camera:
Consistent elevated 55-degree isometric/orthographic perspective throughout. Every pose is shown in a front-right three-quarter view, with the head and front torso facing diagonally toward the viewer and toward image-right. Front face, horns, and front limbs are clearly visible in every single frame.

16 Poses (4 columns x 4 rows):
- Row 1 (Frames 1-4): Idle loop. Four subtle ready idle poses showing breathing expansion and minor shifts of weight while braced.
- Rows 2 & 3 (Frames 5-10): Distinct quadrupedal locomotion cycle with alternating diagonal leg support:
  - Frame 5: Left forefoot reaches forward while right forefoot stays back.
  - Frame 6: Left forefoot plants firmly on the ground.
  - Frame 7: Right forefoot passes left forefoot during gather phase.
  - Frame 8: Right forefoot reaches forward while left forefoot extends back.
  - Frame 9: Right forefoot plants firmly.
  - Frame 10: Left forefoot passes right forefoot returning to stride.
- Rows 3 & 4 (Frames 11-16): Distinct attack sequence:
  - Frame 11: Windup / ready stance, head beginning to lower.
  - Frame 12: Head drops low until horns point forward horizontally, weight gathers onto compressed hind legs.
  - Frame 13: Forward explosive horn shove / lunge forward, front paws briefly airborne.
  - Frame 14: Forefeet land heavily and brace against impact.
  - Frame 15: Recoil and weight absorption after impact.
  - Frame 16: Recovery shifting back to ready position.

Style & Composition:
Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy illustration, sculpted painterly volume with confident brushwork, silver edge highlights, rich grey stone values, glowing cyan-blue seam energy, ochre fractures. Cool upper-left directional lighting. All 16 figures are drawn at the exact same anatomical scale and fit comfortably within the center 60% of their respective cells. Clean solid #FF00FF background with wide empty borders between cells. Strictly no text, no numbers, no grid lines or panel borders, no ground planes, no background scenery, no cropped limbs.
